From ancient seas to advanced materials: How Canada’s ammolite is inspiring the next generation of colour technologies
description: Ammolite occupies a unique position at the intersection of geology, palaeontology, optics and materials science. The fossilised shells buried beneath Alberta's prairies could eventually help inspire a new generation of durable, environmentally resilient and non-fading colour technologies. title: 'I didn't agree,' says Innu Nation Grand Chief of N.L. government's archaeology review
description: The plans of the Newfoundland and Labrador government for speedy entry into new hydroelectric development in Labrador are being thrown into question by Innu Nation Grand Chief Jodie Ashini, who says the province needs to first address the outstanding issue of differences in the Innu and the Provincial Archaeology Office's presentation of Innu history.
